title: 第1925章 月下惊鸿双影去古矿门外众声喧第1924章 十绝冰魄照寒穹
slug: 玄幻长生神子何须妹骨证道
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：玄幻：长生神子，何须妹骨证道！第一卷：默认第1925章月下惊鸿双影去，古矿门外众声喧！（..la）月光所过之处，皆染上一层银白的霜色。
赤炎峰长老只觉得眼前猛地一花。
一阵天旋地转。
整个人如同一片被风吹起的落叶般飘了起来。
等他的视线重新恢复清晰的时候。
他发现自己正站在一片极其熟悉的荒凉地面上。
赤褐色的岩石铺满了视野所及的范围。
远方矗立着几座如同被遗忘了一般古老而残破的黑色山峦……
正是太初古矿的外围矿区。
他回来了。
如同从未离开过一般。
站在当初进入不周山秘境之前的那个位置。
其他所有幸存下来的修士们。
一个接一个地出现在了他的视野之中。
每个人的脸上都带着同样的茫然与震惊。
“我们……出来了？不周山秘境……关上了？”
楚家族老同样面色复杂地环顾着四周。
确认了此地的方位之后。
声音中带着一股说不清道不明的情绪：
“太阴神君投影……把咱们全部传送出来了。”

“这就是太阴法则啊，连空间壁垒都能轻易撕裂的可怕力量。”
赤炎峰长老一屁股坐在了一块赤褐色的岩石上。
老脸上满是虚脱与后怕。
“娘的……老夫这条命是真的硬……进去的时候在断罪台差点没了，出来的时候差点被十绝体自爆炸死……总算是活着出来了……”
紫电峰长老同样靠着一块岩石坐了下来。
声音中带着一种如同劫后余生般的感慨：
“不周山秘境……关闭了。咱们这一趟，活着出来的只有不到五成的人。陨落的人……连尸体都找不回来了。”
执法大长老拄着拐杖站在人群中。
浑浊的老眼中扫过一张张疲惫的面孔。
“太阴神君投影将我们传送出来……说明秘境已经完成了祂的使命。”
“那顾长歌他们呢？那两个蛊仙呢？他们被月光吸走之后去了哪里？是继续留在秘境中，还是被传送到了别的地方？”
没有人能回答他的问题。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Fantasy: Why does the Son of the Immortal God need a sister’s bones to prove the truth! Volume 1: Default Chapter 1925 Two shadows are seen under the moon, and there is a lot of noise outside the gate of the ancient mine! (..la) Wherever the moonlight passes, everything is stained with a layer of silvery frost.
The elder of Chiyanfeng felt his eyes flash suddenly.
There was a sudden spin.
The whole person floated like a fallen leaf blown by the wind.
Wait until his vision becomes clear again.
He found himself standing on an all too familiar patch of desolate ground.
Auburn rocks cover the area as far as the eye can see.
In the distance stand several ancient and broken black mountains that seem to have been forgotten...
It is the outer mining area of Taichu Ancient Mine.
He's back.
It's like you never left.
Standing in the same position before entering the secret realm of Buzhou Mountain.
All the other monks who survived.
One after another appeared in his field of vision.
Everyone had the same confusion and shock on their faces.
"Are we... coming out? The Buzhou Mountain Secret Realm... is closed?"
The elder of the Chu family looked around with the same complex expression.
After confirming the location of this place.
There was an indescribable emotion in his voice:
"The Taiyin Lord's projection...teleported us all out."
"This is the Law of Taiyin, a terrifying force that can easily tear apart space barriers."
Elder Chi Yanfeng sat down on a red-brown rock.
The old face was full of exhaustion and fear.
"Damn... I have a really tough life... I almost died on the scaffold when I went in, and I was almost killed by the Ten Jue Body self-explosion when I came out... I finally came out alive..."
The elder of Zidian Peak also sat down against a rock.
There was a kind of emotion in the voice, like the aftermath of a disaster:
"Buzhou Mountain Secret Realm... is closed. On our trip, less than 50% of the people came out alive. The fallen people... can't even find their bodies."
The chief law enforcement elder stood in the crowd with a cane.
His cloudy old eyes scanned the tired faces.
"The Taiyin God's projection teleported us out... which means that the secret realm has completed its mission."
"What about Gu Changge and the others? Where are the two Gu Immortals? Where did they go after being sucked away by the moonlight? Did they continue to stay in the secret realm, or were they transported to other places?"
No one could answer his question.
